ca63ed93f8845a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the proposal to expand the Lok Sabha to about 816 seats?
o: It aims to implement women's reservation without waiting for post-Census delimitation.
It is intended to apply from the 2029 Lok Sabha elections.
About 273 seats would go to women.
It would change each State's proportion of Lok Sabha seats.
ca63ed93f8845a.x: The proposal keeps the States' proportions of seats unchanged; it avoids waiting for post-Census delimitation and is to operate from the 2029 polls.

cae699f19fb1c3.s: The District Planning Committee under Article 243ZD was introduced by which Constitutional Amendment?
cae699f19fb1c3.x: Article 243ZD and the District Planning Committee belong to the 74th Amendment; the 73rd inserted Part IX on Panchayats.

ca142b780238a0.s: Article 332A, inserted by the Women's Reservation Act, 2023, relates to:
ca142b780238a0.x: Article 332A covers State Assemblies; 330A covers the Lok Sabha and 334A commencement and duration.

ca4715e0bcdef1.s: Under the proposed Lok Sabha expansion for women's reservation, the House would grow from 543 to about how many seats?
ca4715e0bcdef1.x: Seats would rise from 543 to about 816, with about 273 for women, while the States' proportions stay unchanged.

ca676af75e5422.s: In the Governor changes of March 2026, R.N. Ravi was moved to which State?
ca676af75e5422.x: R.N. Ravi went from Tamil Nadu to West Bengal; Jishnu Dev Varma went to Maharashtra, Shiv Pratap Shukla to Telangana and Kavinder Gupta to Himachal Pradesh.

ca9ad191d9ecee.s: Justice Arun Palli, recommended for elevation to the Supreme Court in 2026, came from which High Court?
ca9ad191d9ecee.x: Arun Palli came from the J&K and Ladakh HC; Sheel Nagu came from Punjab & Haryana, S. Chandrashekhar from Bombay and Sanjeev Sachdeva from Madhya Pradesh.

caa280a999e8fa.s: The Election Commission of India was set up on:
caa280a999e8fa.x: The ECI was set up on 25 January 1950, a day before the Constitution came into force.

ca10a67b0b487c.s: Congress MP K.C. Venugopal gave a privilege notice over remarks on opposition MPs against:
ca10a67b0b487c.x: The privilege notice was against PM Narendra Modi; in the Lok Sabha such notices fall under Rule 187 (Rule 222 in the Rajya Sabha).

ca451ded92aca3.s: In the process for removing the Chief Election Commissioner, the inquiry committee has how many members?
ca451ded92aca3.x: A three-member inquiry committee examines the charges; the notice needs 100 Lok Sabha or 50 Rajya Sabha members.

ca696bdc38e927.s: Under the Justice Kurian Joseph Committee's proposal, the President would choose a Governor from how many names proposed by the State?
ca696bdc38e927.x: The State would propose three names, approved by an Assembly majority, and the President would pick one.

cad9a61819da1c.s: In the March 2026 Governor changes, Nand Kishore Yadav was appointed Governor of:
cad9a61819da1c.x: Nand Kishore Yadav became Governor of Nagaland; Syed Ata Hasnain went to Bihar, Shiv Pratap Shukla to Telangana and Jishnu Dev Varma to Maharashtra.

ca682fa72e732e.s: The Prevention of Insults to National Honour Act, 1971 is implemented by which ministry?
ca682fa72e732e.x: The Act is implemented by the Ministry of Home Affairs; the Cabinet decided to amend it to protect Vande Mataram like the Anthem.

ca9c263c7b281d.s: Under Article 145(3), a substantial question of constitutional interpretation must be heard by at least how many judges?
ca9c263c7b281d.x: Article 145(3) requires a bench of at least five judges, a Constitution Bench.

ca1de08768627e.s: Article 21 cannot be suspended during an Emergency because of which Constitutional Amendment?
ca1de08768627e.x: After the 44th Amendment, Articles 20 and 21 cannot be suspended in an Emergency; Article 21 also applies to non-citizens.

cacad4b574c1dd.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Constitution (Scheduled Castes) Order, 1950?
o: Sikhs were added to it in 1956.
Buddhists were added to it in 1956.
A reconverted claimant must prove return, renunciation and acceptance by the original caste.
cacad4b574c1dd.x: Buddhists were added in 1990, not 1956; Sikhs were added in 1956.

ca92a63607a778.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Citizenship (Amendment) Rules, 2026?
o: They came into effect from 30 April 2026.
They provide for e-OCI with digital records and a centralised database.
They allow minors to hold both Indian and foreign passports.
ca92a63607a778.x: Minors cannot hold both Indian and foreign passports under the rules; the other statements are correct.

ca219ded4c5244.s: Under the Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Bill, 2026, fines are revised upward by 10% every:
ca219ded4c5244.x: Fines rise by 10% every three years, not five; imprisonment for minor offences is replaced by civil penalties.

ca3395fb5c4c10.s: Under the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Amendment Bill, 2026, State representatives on the National Council must be:
ca3395fb5c4c10.x: The Bill requires State representatives on the National Council to be Director-level officers.

ca24b376833818.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Essential Commodities Act, 1955, invoked in 2026?
o: It was invoked amid the Iran-linked energy crisis.
Section 3 of the Act regulates supply.
Violations may attract 3 months to 7 years' imprisonment with a fine.
It is administered by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.
ca24b376833818.x: The Act is administered by the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution; the other statements are correct.

ca5ab5410779f0.s: Sikkim was declared India's first fully paperless judiciary State on:
ca5ab5410779f0.x: CJI Surya Kant declared Sikkim fully paperless on 1 May 2026 at Gangtok; Su Sahay was launched on 11 May by NIC and the SC Registry.

ca769027dc2d8f.s: In 2026, West Bengal made Vande Mataram compulsory in which assemblies of all recognised madrasas?
ca769027dc2d8f.x: It was made compulsory in morning assemblies of madrasas, after being made mandatory in all schools.

ca96d397af0796.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the anti-defection law?
o: The Tenth Schedule was added by the 52nd Amendment, 1985.
Disqualification is decided by the President or the Election Commission.
Kihoto Hollohan held the Speaker's decision subject to judicial review.
ca96d397af0796.x: Disqualification is decided by the Speaker or Chairman, not the President or ECI.

cadd15849afe93.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about official languages under the Constitution?
o: Under Article 345 a State may adopt one or more languages in use, or Hindi.
The Eighth Schedule now lists 22 languages.
The Eighth Schedule forms part of Part XVII.
Article 351 provides for the development of Hindi.
cadd15849afe93.x: The Eighth Schedule (14 languages originally, now 22) is not part of Part XVII.

cad5261e5d6832.s: Under the anti-defection law, a nominated member is disqualified on joining a political party:
o: within 15 days of taking the seat
within 6 months of taking the seat
after 6 months of taking the seat
after 1 year of taking the seat
cad5261e5d6832.x: A nominated member attracts disqualification on joining a party after 6 months, not within 6 months.

ca95e72f9bd162.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about anti-defection case law?
o: Keisham Meghachandra Singh (2020) asked for decisions within 6 months.
Keisham Meghachandra Singh (2020) suggested an independent tribunal.
Padi Kaushik Reddy (2025) sought timely decisions without fixing a deadline.
Kihoto Hollohan (1992) made the Speaker's decision subject to judicial review.
ca95e72f9bd162.x: Keisham Meghachandra Singh set a 3-month limit, not 6 months.

caf9057203b034.s: Under the Forest Rights Act, 2006, forest dwellers may NOT be evicted until:
o: the State Forest Act is amended
verification of their claims is complete
the Gram Sabha holds a referendum
caf9057203b034.x: The FRA bars eviction until verification is complete; the Gram Sabha has the central role in recognising rights.

ca751cab457309.s: P. Rathinam (1994), which recognised a right to die under Article 21, was overruled by:
o: Gian Kaur v. State of Punjab (1996)
ca751cab457309.x: Gian Kaur (1996) rejected the right to die and overruled P. Rathinam.

ca18d0d51ebc8f.s: A Lieutenant Governor functions as the Administrator of a Union Territory under which Article?
ca18d0d51ebc8f.x: Under Article 239, UTs are run by the President through an Administrator; the Governor's term is five years under Articles 153-162.

ca88b62e29c247.s: The Kakrapar nuclear power plant is located in which State?
ca88b62e29c247.x: Kakrapar is in Gujarat; Tarapur is in Maharashtra, Rawatbhata in Rajasthan and Kudankulam in Tamil Nadu.

ca2110a7827b8b.s: The Naxalmukt Bharat Abhiyan set which deadline for eliminating Naxalism?
ca2110a7827b8b.x: The target was 31 March 2026; 312 LWE cadres were eliminated in 2025, the highest ever.

ca1a713393095d.s: According to the MHA Year End Review 2025, the Vibrant Villages Programme focuses on:
ca1a713393095d.x: The Vibrant Villages Programme (VVP and VVP-2) concerns border villages, not urban villages.

cad26eac4df2d7.s: Section 39 of the SHANTI Act, 2025 lets the Centre declare nuclear information 'restricted', overriding which law?
cad26eac4df2d7.x: Section 39 lets the Centre declare nuclear information restricted and overrides the RTI Act.

cad95d994c56bb.s: While a resolution for his removal is pending, the Lok Sabha Speaker:
o: may preside and exercise a casting vote
cannot preside, but may speak and vote in the first instance
cad95d994c56bb.x: Under Article 96 the Speaker does not preside but may speak and vote in the first instance; there is no casting vote.

ca1864bedaf5ef.s: Notice of a resolution to remove the Lok Sabha Speaker must be given to the Secretary-General at least how many days in advance?
ca1864bedaf5ef.x: At least 14 days' written notice is needed, and at least 50 members must support leave.

caa7d583cad064.s: The National Judicial Appointments Commission was struck down in 2015 in which case?
caa7d583cad064.x: The Fourth Judges (NJAC) Case of 2015 struck down the NJAC for violating judicial independence, part of the basic structure.

caec806f938a97.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the National Judicial Appointments Commission (NJAC)?
o: Any two members could veto a name.
The Union Law Minister was a member.
It was chaired by the Union Law Minister.
caec806f938a97.x: The CJI chaired the NJAC; the Law Minister was only a member alongside two senior-most judges and two eminent persons.

ca3e2d1453d970.s: Which Article of the Constitution provides for free legal aid and equal justice?
ca3e2d1453d970.x: Article 39A provides for free legal aid and equal justice; Nyaya Setu builds on it.

cab1f6c87ffaa3.s: Which body described the Governor as the 'lynchpin of cooperative federalism'?
cab1f6c87ffaa3.x: The phrase is from the Sarkaria Commission (1988); Shamsher Singh held the Governor a constitutional head acting on aid and advice.

cab063114d3d06.s: Which judgment overruled the JMM bribery (P.V. Narasimha Rao) case and held that bribery is not protected by legislative privilege?
o: Sita Soren v. Union of India
State of Kerala v. K. Ajith
M.S.M. Sharma v. Sri Krishna Sinha
cab063114d3d06.x: Sita Soren (2024) overruled the 1998 JMM case, so bribes linked to speech or vote are not immune.

ca6fad91a3e4da.s: In Dr Jay Thakur v. Union of India, menstrual health was recognised as part of which Article?
ca6fad91a3e4da.x: Menstrual health was held part of Article 21 (dignity, privacy, bodily autonomy) and tied to Articles 14 and 21A. No dated events exist for a sequence question.

caeb0101193e28.s: In Census 2027, self-enumeration through the apps is allowed up to how many days before field work?
caeb0101193e28.x: Census 2027 allows self-enumeration through Android and iOS apps up to 15 days before field work.

cae22ca08c3d9a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Census 2027?
o: It is the 16th Census and the 8th after Independence.
It is conducted under the Census Act, 1948 and Census Rules, 1990.
Its budget is about Rs 11,718 crore.
Its caste count is the first since 1951.
cae22ca08c3d9a.x: Census 2027's caste enumeration is the first since 1931; the other statements are correct.

ca3fe8d6137a30.s: Article 17 of the Constitution deals with:
ca3fe8d6137a30.x: Article 17 abolishes untouchability; the Right against Exploitation is Articles 23-24.

ca4ed97a1ae4c6.s: In 1987 the Law Commission recommended how many judges per 10 lakh population?
ca4ed97a1ae4c6.x: The Law Commission recommended 50; the Government reported only 22 per 10 lakh on the 2011 Census base.

caa6537c6a84ef.s: In projections for an approximately 888-seat Lok Sabha, Tamil Nadu's seats would rise to about:
caa6537c6a84ef.x: Tamil Nadu would go from 39 to about 53; UP is projected at 151, Bihar at 82 and Kerala at 23.

ca14c2cd69476a.s: ECINET, the single digital platform of the Election Commission, integrates more than how many ECI applications?
ca14c2cd69476a.x: ECINET integrates 40+ ECI apps for about one billion voters and follows the RP Acts of 1950 and 1951.

ca0c259bd5997f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the freeze on Lok Sabha seats?
o: The 42nd Amendment froze seats on the 1971 Census.
The 84th Amendment extended the freeze till the first Census after 2021.
The freeze on inter-State seats ends after Census 2027.
The redistribution after Census 2027 would be the first since 1976.
ca0c259bd5997f.x: The 84th Amendment extended the freeze till the first Census after 2026, not 2021.

ca6761dc6ee97f.s: Freedom from arrest in civil cases applies to legislators during a session and how many days before and after it?
ca6761dc6ee97f.x: Under Section 135A of the CPC, legislators are free from civil arrest during a session and 40 days before and after it.

n11e26230575.s: The present inter-State allocation of the 543 Lok Sabha seats is frozen on the basis of which Census?
n11e26230575.x: The allocation is frozen on the 1971 Census (54.8 crore people).

ca04e792f95afe.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Bihar government's order on meat, fish and eggs?
o: It banned their sale near schools.
It banned their sale near temples.
It banned their consumption near schools and temples.
It banned their sale near educational institutions.
ca04e792f95afe.x: The order banned only the sale, not the consumption, of meat, fish and eggs near schools, educational institutions and temples.

ca0d82ba1ed2e3.s: In Telangana's police reorganisation, the Malkajgiri commissionerate was renamed:
ca0d82ba1ed2e3.x: Malkajgiri was renamed Rachakonda; the four commissionerates are Hyderabad, Cyberabad, Malkajgiri and the new Future City.

cad83ce1138506.s: Which Labour Code gave the first legal definition of gig and platform workers?
cad83ce1138506.x: The Code on Social Security, 2020 defined gig and platform workers and created a Social Security Fund, not the Code on Wages.

ca101e0a2db9f0.s: The Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions (OSH) Code, 2020 merged how many Central labour laws?
ca101e0a2db9f0.x: The OSH Code merged 13 laws; the Code on Wages merged 4, the Social Security Code 9 and the IR Code 3.

cadfe282dceccb.s: Which of the following is mandatory under the OSH Code, 2020?
o: A ban on women working before 6 am
Appointment letters and an annual free health check
A factory licence for units with 10 workers using power
Contract labour rules for contractors with 20 workers
cadfe282dceccb.x: Appointment letters and an annual free health check are mandatory; women may work before 6 am or after 7 pm with consent and safety measures.

ca95c114cf6e06.s: Under the amended Uttarakhand UCC Rules, the Registrar can no longer inform the parents of live-in registrants below what age?
ca95c114cf6e06.x: The Registrar cannot inform parents of registrants below 21; disclosure of pregnancy and children in live-ins was also deleted.

ca5f9c51254132.s: The Supreme Court banned Salwa Judum in which year?
ca5f9c51254132.x: The SC banned Salwa Judum in 2011; Clear–Hold–Develop is a security strategy.

ca3e6f6ec1818e.s: Under the DPDP framework, the entity that decides the purpose and means of processing personal data is the:
ca3e6f6ec1818e.x: The Data Fiduciary decides purpose and means; the Data Principal is the individual whose data is processed.

cad09498e65a6a.s: Which phase of the e-Courts Project introduced e-filing, e-payment, NJDG and virtual courts?
o: The 2005 National Policy and Action Plan
cad09498e65a6a.x: Phase II brought e-filing, e-payment, NJDG and virtual courts; Phase I computerised 14,000+ courts and set up the Case Information System.

ca7360d224b5c7.s: Sections 38A and 38B, cited for personality rights as performer and moral rights, belong to which Act?
ca7360d224b5c7.x: Sections 38A and 38B are in the Copyright Act, 1957; passing off is under Section 27 of the Trade Marks Act, and Article 21 is also a basis.

cac529aeefb954.s: Under which Article can Parliament create an All-India Judicial Service?
cac529aeefb954.x: Article 312 lets Parliament create new All-India Services, including the AIJS, which President Murmu backed on Constitution Day 2023.

ca2d7e38756d7e.s: Under the Constitution (130th Amendment) Bill, 2025, a Minister detained for how many consecutive days would lose office?
ca2d7e38756d7e.x: Detention for 30 consecutive days on charges carrying 5+ years leads to removal by the 31st day.

ca688d4f0787dd.s: Under the Online Gaming Act, 2025, which category is casual or educational, involves no betting and is promoted by the government?
ca688d4f0787dd.x: Online social games involve no betting and are promoted; Real Money Games, including fantasy sports, are banned.

cad4a70209bf06.s: The IIM (Amendment) Bill, 2025 amends the Indian Institutes of Management Act of which year?
cad4a70209bf06.x: The Bill amends the IIM Act, 2017 to set up the 22nd IIM, with admissions from 2025–26.

ca7bbec3ac8595.s: The Constitution (130th Amendment) Bill, 2025 amends which Article, under which Ministers hold office during the President's pleasure?
ca7bbec3ac8595.x: The Bill amends Article 75, which provides that Ministers hold office during the President's pleasure.

cabf5298545cbb.s: Which Constitutional Amendment is known as the 'Mini-Constitution'?
cabf5298545cbb.x: The 42nd Amendment (1976) is called the Mini-Constitution; it added 'Socialist' and 'Secular' to the Preamble.

ca6818a68c07db.s: The first use of Andhra Pradesh's SC sub-categorisation Ordinance is for:
ca6818a68c07db.x: The draft Ordinance, approved by the Cabinet under N. Chandrababu Naidu, is first used for DSC teacher recruitment.

n14ca2652787.s: What was the status of the Constitution (130th Amendment) Bill, 2025 by July 2026?
o: Defeated in the Lok Sabha by 298 votes to 230
Left out of the Monsoon Session agenda, with its JPC deadline extended
Merged with the simultaneous elections Bill
n14ca2652787.x: The Bill stayed with a Joint Parliamentary Committee whose deadline was extended and was left out of the July 2026 agenda; the 298-230 defeat relates to the 131st Bill.

cadac0c6747ddb.s: Which Commission recommended that the Governor decide on Bills within six months?
cadac0c6747ddb.x: The Punchhi Commission (2010) gave the six-month limit for Governors; Sarkaria (1988) asked the President to dispose of reserved Bills in six months.

caabbbfe57d9ce.s: Article 143(2) allows the President to refer to the Supreme Court:
o: Any question of law of public importance
Disputes over pre-Constitution treaties and agreements
Disputes between the Centre and States
Disputes over the election of the President
caabbbfe57d9ce.x: Article 143(2) covers disputes on pre-Constitution treaties; 143(1) covers questions of law or fact of public importance.

cac3598d1b4e3b.s: In electoral roll revision, on whom does the burden of proving citizenship lie?
cac3598d1b4e3b.x: The burden lies on new registrants (Lal Babu Hussain, 1995); ECI powers under Article 324 are plenary but within constitutional limits.

ca5d11c1e8b9c8.s: The Whistle Blowers Protection Act, cited as poorly implemented, was enacted in:
ca5d11c1e8b9c8.x: The Whistle Blowers Protection Act dates from 2014; ProPublica is a US non-profit model.

cac62590cdb2a7.s: Under the Supreme Court's Waqf ruling, the Central Waqf Council may have at most how many non-Muslim members out of 22?
cac62590cdb2a7.x: The Central Waqf Council may have up to 4 non-Muslims of 22; State Waqf Boards up to 3 of 11.

caca218cce7fa5.s: Holding that religious practice continues at waqf sites that are protected monuments, the Supreme Court cited Section 5(6) of:
o: the Antiquities and Art Treasures Act, 1972
caca218cce7fa5.x: The Court cited Section 5(6) of the Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains (AMASR) Act, 1958; the Act was upheld overall.

ca31941e4c4ed0.s: What is the minimum age for election as Vice-President of India?
ca31941e4c4ed0.x: A candidate must be a citizen, at least 35 and hold no office of profit; re-election is allowed. The facts carry no dates for a sequence question.

cac061ec4313cc.s: Which Article recognises the right of minorities to establish and administer educational institutions?
cac061ec4313cc.x: Article 30(1) protects minority educational institutions; the RTE framework provides for the TET.

n79836152d6e.s: Which provision of the Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025 did the Supreme Court stay in September 2025?
o: The requirement of five years' practice of Islam to create a waqf
Continuance of religious practice at protected monuments
Decision of title disputes by the Waqf Tribunal
n79836152d6e.x: The five-year-practice rule and the Collector's power under Section 3C were stayed; mandatory registration was upheld.

ca9ab724b8ce19.s: In the Kerala hijab-row debate, a school's institutional autonomy is linked with which Article?
ca9ab724b8ce19.x: Article 19(1)(g) is linked with institutional autonomy, while Article 21/21A is the education angle and Article 25 religious freedom.

ca71149c781722.s: The Election Commission advises the President on the disqualification of Members of Parliament under which Article?
ca71149c781722.x: Under Article 103 the President acts on the ECI's opinion; Article 192 is the parallel for State legislators. No dates exist for a sequence question.

cae7717ac70e20.s: Federalism was recognised as part of the Basic Structure in which case?
cae7717ac70e20.x: Kesavananda Bharati (1973) recognised federalism as part of the Basic Structure; the Rajya Sabha falls under Article 83.

ca4940a0d2d7f6.s: Under the proposed Uttarakhand UCC Rules amendments, non-registration or a false declaration is punishable with up to:
ca4940a0d2d7f6.x: Non-registration or false declaration attracts up to 3 months or Rs 25,000; live-in with a minor up to 6 months or Rs 50,000.

ca7951d7e06318.s: Assam Police summoned The Wire's Siddharth Varadarajan and Karan Thapar over Operation Sindoor coverage under which Section of the BNS?
ca7951d7e06318.x: They were summoned under Section 152 of the BNS; the SC protected them.

ca496c563fdbaf.s: Section 152 of the BNS, which does not require a high standard of proof of intent, is seen as a rebranded version of which IPC provision?
ca496c563fdbaf.x: Section 152 BNS is seen as rebranded Section 124A IPC (in abeyance since 2022); Article 19(1)(a) protects free speech.

ca0ddd51703158.s: In Article 352, the 44th Amendment replaced the words 'internal disturbance' with:
ca0ddd51703158.x: The 44th Amendment (1978) changed 'internal disturbance' to 'armed rebellion'; 'external aggression' was already a ground.

cadfd121be7b67.s: Offences under the Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025 are:
cadfd121be7b67.x: Offences are cognisable and non-bailable; offering Real Money Games carries up to 3 years and Rs 1 crore, and foreign operators are blocked through Interpol.

new.s: How many votes did the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2026 get in favour in the Lok Sabha in April 2026?
new.x: It got 298 votes for and 230 against out of 528, short of the 326 needed, so it was defeated.

new.s: The Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2026 proposed raising the Lok Sabha maximum from 550 to:
new.x: It sought a cap of 850 (815 from States and 35 from UTs) by amending Article 81.

new.s: How many times has the Delimitation Commission been constituted in India?
new.x: It was constituted four times: 1952, 1963, 1973 and 2002.

new.s: Which Article bars courts from questioning delimitation orders?
new.x: Article 329(a) bars judicial review of delimitation orders, which have the force of law.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 131st Amendment package of 2026?
o: It proposed delimitation on the 2011 Census.
It included a Union Territories Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026.
It automatically raised the strength of the Rajya Sabha.
new.x: Rajya Sabha strength under Article 80 does not change automatically; the other statements are correct.

new.s: Under Article 75(1A), the Council of Ministers may not exceed what share of the Lok Sabha strength?
new.x: Article 75(1A) caps the Council of Ministers at 15%, so an 850-member House would allow about 122 ministers.

new.s: From which date was the 106th Amendment Act (women's reservation) brought into force?
new.x: The Act, passed in September 2023, was brought into force from 16 April 2026 as a procedural step.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Women's Reservation Act, 2023:
1. It provides a sub-quota for OBC women.
2. It applies to the Delhi Legislative Assembly.
3. It is valid for 15 years.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The quota covers the Lok Sabha, State Assemblies and the Delhi Assembly for 15 years; there is no OBC sub-quota.

new.s: Under the 2023 Act on appointing Election Commissioners, the Search Committee is headed by the:
new.x: The Search Committee is headed by the Law Minister with two senior bureaucrats and prepares a shortlist of five.

new.s: Gyanesh Kumar became Chief Election Commissioner on:
new.x: Gyanesh Kumar became CEC on 19 February 2025, succeeding Rajiv Kumar, who retired on 18 February 2025.

new.s: The 91st Amendment, 2003 removed which exception from the anti-defection law?
o: Defiance of whip condoned in 15 days
new.x: The 91st Amendment removed the one-third 'split' exception but kept the two-thirds merger protection.

new.s: According to ADR, which national party received no donations above Rs 20,000 for 19 years?
new.x: BSP declared no donation above Rs 20,000 for 19 years; BJP received Rs 6,074 crore in 2024-25.

new.s: The Meghalaya Official Languages Ordinance, 2026 was promulgated under which Article?
new.x: A Governor promulgates ordinances under Article 213; the ordinance made Khasi and Garo official with English.

new.s: The Justice Kurian Joseph Committee proposed that Governors decide on State List Bills within:
new.x: It proposed a decision within 15 days on State List Bills, and reasons within 60 days for reserved Bills.

new.s: Which of the following pairs of Constitutional Amendment and language added to the Eighth Schedule is correctly matched?
new.x: The 92nd (2003) added Bodo, Santhali, Maithili and Dogri; the 21st added Sindhi, the 71st Konkani, Manipuri and Nepali, and the 102nd concerned the NCBC.

new.s: Who delivered the lone dissent in the 2018 Sabarimala verdict?
new.x: The 2018 verdict was 4:1, with Justice Indu Malhotra dissenting; Rule 3(b) was struck down.

new.s: Under Hamsanandini Nanduri v. Union of India (2026), adoptive mothers get how many weeks of maternity leave regardless of the child's age?
new.x: The SC struck down Section 60(4) of the Code on Social Security, 2020, so all adoptive mothers get 12 weeks.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT part of the 'Triple Test' for an 'industry' from Bangalore Water Supply (1978)?
o: Production or distribution of goods or services
new.x: Under the Triple Test, profit motive and capital are irrelevant.

new.s: Which case led to CCTV cameras being required in police stations?
o: Prakash Singh v. Union of India
new.x: Paramvir Singh Saini concerns CCTV in police stations; D.K. Basu gave arrest safeguards and Prakash Singh Police Complaints Authorities.

new.s: Which doctrine did the Allahabad High Court apply in holding that the Forest Rights Act overrides earlier laws?
new.x: Lex posterior derogat priori means a later law overrides an earlier one; the HC set aside the DLC's rejection of Tharu claims.

new.s: The Bhojshala complex in Dhar was held by the MP High Court to be a temple of which deity?
new.x: The HC held Bhojshala to be historically a Saraswati Temple and Sanskrit learning centre of King Bhoja (Parmar).

new.s: The Supreme Court's special Lok Adalat 'Samadhan Samaroh 2026' is scheduled for:
new.x: The special Lok Adalat runs from 21 to 23 August 2026, with registration closing on 31 May 2026.

new.s: The court modernisation committee, whose report is due on 31 August 2026, is headed by:
new.x: Justice Aravind Kumar heads the committee, with a target of Rs 40,000-50,000 crore.

new.s: Under the Tribunals Reforms Bill, 2026, tribunal members hold office for 5 years or until what age?
new.x: The Bill, which replaces the 2021 Act, sets a tenure of 5 years or age 70.

new.s: The Supreme Court's sanctioned strength, including the CJI, was set at 31 by the Act of which year?
new.x: The 2008 Act set 31; the 2019 Act raised it to 34 and the 2026 Bill proposes 38.

new.s: The Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Bill, 2026 amends 784 provisions in how many Central Acts?
new.x: It amends 784 provisions in 79 Central Acts run by 23 ministries; 717 are decriminalised.

new.s: The Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Amendment Bill, 2026 was introduced by which ministry?
o: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Ministry of Women and Child Development
new.x: It was introduced by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (Minister Virendra Kumar).

new.s: The Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Rules, 2026 contain how many Rules?
new.x: The Rules have 6 Parts and 26 Rules and were notified under Section 19 of the 2025 Act.

new.s: Under the Assam Uniform Civil Code Bill, 2026, a live-in relationship must be registered within:
new.x: The Bill requires live-in relationships to be registered within one month; it also bans polygamy.

new.s: What is the reference date for Census 2027?
new.x: The reference date is midnight of 1 March 2027; snowbound areas use 1 October 2026.

new.s: Delhi's Dwarka Metro Station was renamed in May 2026 as:
new.x: The Delhi State Names Authority renamed it Dwarka-Kakrola Metro Station on 27 May 2026.

new.s: Which of the following pairs of old and new names approved in Delhi in May 2026 is correctly matched?
o: Rohini West Metro Station – Dwarka-Kakrola Metro Station
Dwarka Metro Station – Dr Baba Saheb Ambedkar Hospital Metro Station
Britannia Chowk – Dr Baba Saheb Ambedkar Chowk
new.x: Britannia Chowk became Ashwini Chopra (Minna) Chowk; Rohini West became Dr Baba Saheb Ambedkar Hospital and Dwarka became Dwarka-Kakrola.

new.s: After declaring Naxalism eliminated, the MHA placed 37 districts in which new category?
new.x: 37 districts are in the new 'Legacy and Thrust' category; the other new category is 'Districts of Concern'.

new.s: The Atomic Energy Act, 1962, now replaced by the SHANTI Act, had itself replaced the Atomic Energy Act of:
new.x: The 1962 Act replaced the 1948 Act; SHANTI replaces both the 1962 Act and the CLND Act, 2010.

new.s: The Atomic Energy Regulatory Board, given statutory status by the SHANTI Act, was set up in:
new.x: The AERB was set up in 1983 and is now statutory and accountable to Parliament.

new.s: What is India's target for nuclear power capacity by 2047?
new.x: Capacity is 8.18 GW now, with targets of 22 GW by 2032 and 100 GW by 2047.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the SHANTI Act, 2025:
1. It retains supplier liability as under the CLND Act, 2010.
2. Liability above the operator's cap is covered by a Nuclear Liability Fund.
3. Spent fuel management remains with the Centre.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Supplier liability is eliminated, so 1 is wrong; the Liability Fund and the Centre's control of spent fuel are correct.

new.s: The first motion to remove a Lok Sabha Speaker, in 1954, was moved against:
new.x: The 1954 motion was against G.V. Mavalankar, the first Speaker; motions against Hukam Singh (1966) and Balram Jakhar (1987) also failed.

new.s: Which case held that a Speaker cannot decide disqualification petitions while a notice for his removal is pending?
new.x: Nabam Rebia (2016) held so; Kihoto Hollohan made Tenth Schedule decisions reviewable and Subhash Desai asked the Speaker to set timelines.

new.s: Parliamentary privileges extend to which of the following?
new.x: Privileges extend to the Attorney General, not the President.

new.s: The Committee of Privileges of the Rajya Sabha has how many members?
new.x: The Rajya Sabha committee has 10 members and the Lok Sabha committee 15; both are semi-judicial.

new.s: Under the Third Judges Case (1998), the collegium consists of the CJI and how many senior-most judges?
new.x: The Third Judges Case set the collegium as the CJI plus the four senior-most judges; the Second created the collegium.

new.s: The NJAC, struck down in 2015, was created by which Constitutional Amendment?
new.x: The 99th Amendment, 2014 created the NJAC; it was struck down for violating judicial independence.

new.s: Which city is NOT among the regional benches of the Supreme Court proposed in P. Wilson's Bill?
new.x: The proposed benches are New Delhi, Kolkata, Mumbai and Chennai; Hyderabad is not included.

new.s: Nyaya Setu, which gives free legal services on WhatsApp, was first launched in:
new.x: Nyaya Setu was first launched in August 2024; its AI chatbot form came on 1 January 2026.

new.s: Which case first saw a High Court recognise a right to die?
new.x: In Maruti Dubal (1987) a High Court recognised a right to die; Gian Kaur later rejected it.

new.s: In Dr Jay Thakur v. Union of India, free biodegradable sanitary pads were directed for girls in:
new.x: The SC directed free biodegradable sanitary pads for girls in Classes 6 to 12, calling it a constitutional responsibility.

new.s: In the 2018 Sabarimala verdict, the Anti-Exclusion Test was proposed by:
new.x: Justice D.Y. Chandrachud proposed the Anti-Exclusion Test (dignity and equality); Justice Indu Malhotra dissented.

new.s: The Telangana village Jainz Tirumalapur in Wanaparthy district was renamed:
new.x: Jainz Tirumalapur (Gopalpeta, Wanaparthy) was renamed Jayanna Tirumalapur.

new.s: The PESA Act, 1996 extends Part IX of the Constitution to which areas?
new.x: PESA extends Part IX to Fifth Schedule areas; Jharkhand notified its PESA Rules in January 2026.

new.s: What is the minimum age for appointment as a Governor?
new.x: A Governor must be at least 35 years old and cannot be an MP or MLA.

new.s: The ECI app 'Saksham' is meant for:
new.x: Saksham serves PwD voters; cVIGIL is for citizens and Suvidha for candidates.

new.s: Electoral bonds were valid for how many days from issue?
new.x: Electoral bonds, issued by SBI, were valid for 15 days.

new.s: Corporate donations to political parties were banned during:
new.x: Corporate donations were banned from 1969 to 1985.

new.s: The 2002–08 Delimitation Commission:
new.x: It only redrew internal boundaries on the 2001 Census; inter-State seats stayed frozen at 543.

new.s: Phase 1 of Census 2027, the House Listing and Housing Census, runs during:
new.x: HLHC runs April to September 2026; Population Enumeration is in February 2027.

new.s: The Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, which completed 50 years in February 2026, was enacted in:
new.x: It was enacted in 1976 after an ordinance of 25 October 1975; Article 23 bans forced labour.

new.s: Which I4C initiative registers an FIR automatically for cyber financial crimes?
new.x: I4C's e-Zero FIR registers FIRs automatically for cyber financial crimes.

new.s: PRAGATI, which held its 50th meeting, was launched in:
new.x: PRAGATI was launched in 2015; it reviewed the Bembla Irrigation Project, commissioned 30 June 2025.

new.s: The Right to Disconnect Bill, 2025 was introduced as a:
new.x: It is a Private Member's Bill and India's first formal legislative attempt on after-hours digital work.

new.s: Under the Industrial Relations Code, 2020, the worker threshold for needing permission for layoff, retrenchment or closure was raised from 100 to:
new.x: The threshold rose from 100 to 300 workers, not 500.

new.s: Under the Code on Social Security, 2020, aggregators contribute what share of annual turnover for gig and platform workers?
new.x: Aggregators pay 1–2% of annual turnover, capped at 5% of the amount payable to gig workers.

new.s: Under the Code on Wages, 2019, total deductions from wages are capped at:
new.x: Deductions are capped at 50%; overtime is at least twice the normal rate.

new.s: The draft Digital Personal Data Protection Bill was prepared by which committee in 2018?
new.x: The Srikrishna Committee prepared the 2018 draft; the DPDP Act was passed in 2023 and Rules notified on 14 November 2025.

new.s: Under the DPDP Rules, 2025, which right lets a person name someone to act after their death or incapacity?
new.x: The digital nominee acts after death or incapacity; erasure and correction are separate rights.

new.s: Since 1984, the Administrator of Chandigarh has been the:
new.x: The Governor of Punjab has administered Chandigarh since 1984; Chandigarh is not listed in Article 240.

new.s: The Draft Registration Bill, 2025, released by the Ministry of Rural Development, replaces the Registration Act of:
new.x: It replaces the Registration Act, 1908, and cuts the jail term for offences from 7 to 3 years.

new.s: How many members are on the Joint Parliamentary Committee examining the 130th Amendment Bill?
new.x: The JPC has 31 members: 21 from the Lok Sabha and 10 from the Rajya Sabha.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Supreme Court's November 2025 opinion on the Presidential Reference?
o: It rejected fixed, court-imposed timelines for Governors.
It accepted the idea of 'deemed assent'.
It allowed limited mandamus for prolonged, unexplained inaction.
It was given by a five-judge Bench led by CJI B.R. Gavai.
new.x: The opinion rejected deemed assent; Article 142 cannot substitute the Governor's or President's role.

new.s: The 8 April 2025 judgment setting timelines for the Tamil Nadu Governor was given by Justices J.B. Pardiwala and:
new.x: Justices J.B. Pardiwala and R. Mahadevan held the delay illegal and set three-month timelines under Article 142.

new.s: Who is the Executive Chairman of the National Legal Services Authority (NALSA)?
o: The second senior-most Supreme Court judge
new.x: The CJI is Patron-in-Chief, and the second senior-most SC judge is Executive Chairman.

new.s: Under Rejanish KV v. K. Deepa (2025), how many years of combined advocacy and judicial service are needed for direct recruitment as a district judge?
new.x: The SC set 7 years of combined experience and a uniform minimum age of 35.

new.s: In which case was DNA evidence rejected because the sample lay in the Malkhana for two months?
new.x: In Rahul v. Delhi (2022) the sample sat in the Malkhana for two months; in Manoj it was taken from an open area.

new.s: Which State issued India's first industrial-hemp licences, in 2018?
new.x: Uttarakhand issued the first industrial-hemp licences in 2018; the first medical cannabis clinic opened in Bengaluru in 2020.

new.s: Which of the following pairs of case and ruling is correctly matched?
o: Pramati (2014) – Exempted only unaided minority schools from RTE
Society for Unaided Private Schools of Rajasthan (2012) – Exempted aided and unaided minority schools
Faheema Shirin (2019) – Internet access part of Article 21
Anuradha Bhasin (2020) – Upheld indefinite internet shutdowns
new.x: Faheema Shirin (Kerala HC, 2019) held internet access part of Article 21; Pramati exempted aided and unaided minority schools, and Anuradha Bhasin ruled against indefinite shutdowns.

new.s: Who was the Returning Officer for the 2025 Vice-Presidential election?
new.x: Rajya Sabha Secretary General P.C. Mody was Returning Officer; C.P. Radhakrishnan defeated B. Sudershan Reddy.

new.s: ECINET, the Election Commission's integrated platform, was announced on:
new.x: ECINET was announced on 4 May 2025 and first used in the 19 June 2025 bypolls.

new.s: The Immigration and Foreigners (Exemption) Order, 2025 exempts Sri Lankan Tamils who took shelter in India on or before:
new.x: Sri Lankan Tamils who sheltered on or before 9 January 2015 are exempt; the order does not confer citizenship.

new.s: Under the CAA 2019, the six minorities from Pakistan, Afghanistan and Bangladesh must have entered India before:
new.x: The CAA cut-off is 31 December 2014; Sri Lankan Tamils are excluded from the CAA.

new.s: In September 2025, Ahmednagar railway station in Maharashtra was renamed:
new.x: Ahmednagar station became Ahilyanagar after Union Home Ministry approval.

new.s: Under the May 2025 measures for Ladakh, what share of jobs was reserved for locals?
new.x: 95% of jobs were reserved for locals, with 33% women's reservation in the LAHDC.

new.s: Who wrote 'Sons of the Soil' (1978), cited in the debate on domicile politics?
new.x: Myron Weiner wrote 'Sons of the Soil' (1978); Alok Ranjan coined 'provincial citizenship'.

new.s: Phase III of the e-Courts Project (2023–2027) has an outlay of:
new.x: Phase III, cleared in September 2023, has Rs 7,210 crore, 1,150 virtual courts and 25 PB cloud.

new.s: Who was the first chairman of the Public Service Commission set up in October 1926?
new.x: Sir Ross Barker was the first chairman; the Lee Commission (1924) had recommended the body.

new.s: According to the India Justice Report 2025, women make up what share of Supreme Court judges?
new.x: Women are 3.1% of SC judges (1 of 34) and 14% of HC judges.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Delimitation Commission:
1. It is appointed by the President.
2. Its orders must be approved by Parliament.
3. It decides the SC/ST reserved constituencies.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Its orders have the force of law and are laid before Parliament only for information, so 2 is wrong; 1 and 3 are correct.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (Act – Supreme Court strength including the CJI) is correctly matched?
new.x: The 1960 Act set 14; the 1977 Act set 18, 1986 set 26, 2008 set 31 and 2019 set 34, with 38 proposed in 2026.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about parliamentary privileges?
o: Under Article 105(3) they follow the British House of Commons as on 26 January 1950.
No law defining them has been enacted.
The Committee of Privileges is a judicial body.
The 44th Amendment protects fair press reporting of proceedings.
new.x: The Committee of Privileges is semi-judicial, not judicial; the other statements are correct.

new.s: Which of the following pairs of Judges Case and outcome is correctly matched?
o: Fourth Judges (2015) – Collegium of CJI and four judges
new.x: The First Judges Case gave executive primacy; the Second created the collegium, the Third set CJI + 4, and the Fourth struck down the NJAC.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the election of the Vice-President of India:
1. Nominated members of Parliament vote in it.
2. Elected members of State Legislative Assemblies vote in it.
3. It is held by single transferable vote and secret ballot.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Under Article 66 only elected and nominated MPs vote; State MLAs do not, so 2 is wrong.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Labour Codes:
1. Labour is in the Concurrent List.
2. A negotiating union needs 51% membership under the IR Code.
3. Fixed-term employees get gratuity only after 5 years.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Fixed-term employees get gratuity after 1 year (5 years is for permanent employees), so 3 is wrong.
